options: Shorting all voltage sources and opening all current sources
Opening all voltage sources and shorting all current sources
questions.answer: To find the equivalent Thevenin resistance (Rth) of a linear circuit, ideal voltage sources are short-circuited and ideal current sources are open-circuited.

questions.question_text: The internal resistance for the maximum transfer of power should be _______
questions.answer: The Maximum Power Transfer Theorem dictates that maximum power is delivered to the load when the source's internal resistance is exactly equal to the load resistance.

questions.question_text: The 2ohm and 3 ohm resistor are in series the equivalent resistance is
questions.answer: For resistors in a simple series combination, equivalent resistance is the sum: R_total = 2 Ω + 3 Ω = 5 Ω.

questions.question_text: In a star connected system, the current flowing through the line is _______
questions.answer: Because the line and the respective phase coil are in series in a star (Y) connection, the line current is exactly equal to the phase current (IL = Iph).

questions.question_text: How many AND gates are required to realize A.B+C.D+E
questions.answer: The expression has two product terms (A.B and C.D), each requiring one AND gate, totaling 2 AND gates. The results (along with E) are then passed through an OR gate.

questions.question_text: The structure of the IGBT is a
options: P-N-P structure connected by a MOS gate
N-N-P-P structure connected by a MOS gate
P-N-P-N structure connected by a MOS gate
N-P-N-P structure connected by a MOS gate
questions.answer: The internal physical structure of an IGBT is a four-layer semiconductor (P-N-P-N) configuration governed by a MOSFET-style insulated gate.
A Silicon Controlled Rectifier (SCR) is fundamentally a four-layer device (P-N-P-N structure) possessing exactly three internal PN junctions (J1, J2, and J3).

questions.question_text: Thin laminations are used in a machine in order to reduce _______
questions.answer: By constructing magnetic cores using thin laminated steel sheets separated by insulation, the pathway for circulating eddy currents is restricted, thus dramatically reducing eddy current losses.

questions.question_text: Commutator in DC generator is used for _______
options: convert AC armature current in to DC
questions.answer: Even in a DC generator, the internal current generated within the rotating armature coils is alternating (AC). The commutator serves as a mechanical rectifier to convert it into unidirectional DC at the terminals.

questions.question_text: The frame of an induction motor is usually made of
questions.answer: Cast iron provides high mechanical strength, good damping characteristics, and is cost-effective, making it standard for manufacturing induction motor exterior frames.

questions.question_text: An elevator drive is required to operate in
questions.answer: Elevators require motoring and braking actions in both upward and downward moving directions, which necessitates comprehensive four-quadrant drive operation.

questions.question_text: LEDs fabricated from the gallium arsenide emit radiation in the
questions.answer: Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) semiconductors inherently possess a bandgap that corresponds to photon emissions located in the non-visible infrared spectrum.

questions.question_text: A device consists of a photo transistor and a led is _______
questions.answer: An optocoupler (or optoisolator) packages a light-emitting diode and a photodetector (like a photo transistor) to transfer signals optically while maintaining electrical isolation.

questions.question_text: In Ultrasonic proximity sensors the distance between the sensor and the target is determined by
options: time taken by reflected light to reach back to sensor.
time taken by the sound to reflect back to the sensor.
questions.answer: Ultrasonic sensors use the 'Time of Flight' principle, analyzing the exact time it takes for an emitted high-frequency sound wave to strike a target and echo back.

questions.question_text: _______ is the principle of operation of LVDT
questions.answer: The Linear Variable Differential Transformer calculates displacement by taking advantage of varying mutual magnetic inductance between a primary and secondary coils.

questions.question_text: For proper earthing, what should be the maximum value of earth resistance while carrying out the testing of the earth's continuity path?
questions.answer: For a highly reliable and safe grounding system, the continuity path and overall earth resistance are ideally maintained well below 1 ohm.

questions.question_text: Identify the device which is used to give the signal to the circuit breaker at the time of fault
questions.answer: A protective relay constantly monitors the circuit conditions and, upon detecting a fault, actively sends a trip signal to the circuit breaker to disconnect the line.

questions.question_text: Electric vehicles and inductionhybrid vehicles have the following components in common except _______
questions.answer: Fully electric vehicles (EVs) utilize purely electric powertrains, entirely omitting the internal combustion engine found in hybrid models.

questions.question_text: The highest transmission voltage used in India is
questions.answer: At a fully commercial operational scale, the highest operational AC power transmission voltage utilized across the Indian power grid is 765 kV.
